يستوضحوا (form X)

# يُسْتَوْضَحُوا (yustawḍaḥū) /jus.taw.dˤa.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
